_about: Independent oracle for the triage live-arm efficacy measurement. See harness/PROBLEM.md. triage's value-prop is correct PRIORITIZATION + cross-tool CORRELATION of findings. So this fixture is a set of 12 abstracted operational/security findings with (a) a human-curated EXPERT priority ranking (the oracle for rank correlation) and (b) known correlation GROUPS (findings that share a root cause). Findings are ABSTRACTED from documented incidents (rules/incidents/) — no live MCP, no sensitive external data. The arms see only `finding` text (priority/group hidden). Anti-circularity: the expert ranking + groups are human-curated historical ground truth; the producer never sets them. Priorities follow uncontroversial severity logic (active credential exposure = top; cosmetic nudge = bottom).

scoring.rank: expert_rank is 1=highest priority .. 12=lowest. Metric = Spearman correlation between the arm's ranking and expert_rank (hand-rolled in grade.py, no scipy).
scoring.correlation: true_groups = sets of finding ids that share ONE root cause. Metric = pair-level precision/recall/F1 of the arm's proposed correlation groups vs true_groups.

findings.finding: A cloud-provider API token was printed into the session transcript by a wide process-listing diagnostic that inlined environment variables; the value persists in saved logs.
A second API token was exposed in a tool result by a different process-listing command that also dumped the inlined environment block.
A verbose curl invocation with an Authorization header echoed the full bearer token to stdout, which landed in the transcript.
boto3/AWS calls hang for ~48 seconds because IPv6 AAAA records are unreachable over the split-DNS VPN; a documented IPv4 workaround exists.
An MCP server hangs on startup because its isolated venv lacks the IPv4-forcing patch, so it stalls on an unreachable IPv6 address.
A script crashes with a UnicodeDecodeError on an API response because Windows defaulted the read to cp1252 instead of utf-8.
A committed YAML file fails the linter with a byte-0,0 error because a text write translated LF line endings to CRLF on Windows.
A skill's SKILL.md is 503 lines, slightly over the 500-line style guidance (a soft A-grade quality nudge); it still validates.
A test run hangs on Windows for one unrelated component (an environment-specific subprocess that blocks); it passes in Linux CI.
A documentation page still references a tool that was deprecated two releases ago (doc drift, no functional impact).
A build step shows spurious modified-file churn on Windows because it rewrites files with CRLF endings that git then normalizes to LF.
The merge queue is currently holding several green PRs unmerged (queue timing); no PR is failing, the merge is just delayed.
